verdict.rationale: Groq's docs describe the API as OpenAI-compatible: an agent can switch to it by changing only the api_key and base_url (https://api.groq.com/openai/v1) in OpenAI client libraries. Its Chat Completions API supports standard streaming (stream=True), the `tools` parameter for function calling and JSON-schema structured outputs, and its Responses API is described as fully compatible with OpenAI's. The docs themselves say "mostly compatible" without listing here which parameters differ. missing for 10: an enumerated list of unsupported or divergent OpenAI parameters, independent hands-on corroboration of drop-in provider switching mid-workflow.
